name: n8n
description: Panel-only extension (transport=none — no process, no MCP server, no health ping): surfaces the local n8n workflow editor (port 5678) inside the Wylde Tauri shell's Tools tab. The Wylde-side n8n surface is the Rust `wylde-n8n` service (pipe \\.\pipe\wylde-n8n, taxonomy reorg TX S3); the n8n daemon itself is external and user-managed. This manifest only declares the UI panel.
